families.label: Impulse breakout with range expansion
families.mechanism: Close breaks a completed-bar price channel while the signal bar range expands relative to a predeclared reference.

families.label: Session and prior-range breakout
families.mechanism: Close breaks a completed institutional-session or prior-day range; only the first signal per direction and UTC date is retained.

families.label: Failed breakout / range excursion reversion
families.mechanism: Price trades beyond a completed rolling, session, or prior-day range and closes back inside it; the signal is opposite the excursion.

families.label: Range compression followed by expansion breakout
families.mechanism: A completed short range is narrower than an earlier comparison range; the signal bar expands and closes outside the compressed range.

families.label: Multi-hour trend pullback and resumption
families.mechanism: A predeclared multi-bar trend is followed by one opposite bar; the signal bar resumes the trend by breaking the pullback bar extreme.

families.label: Donchian / trading-range channel breakout
families.mechanism: Close crosses beyond the high or low of a completed rolling channel. Cross-only logic prevents repeated signals while price remains outside.

families.label: Exponential moving-average trend cross
families.mechanism: Fast EMA crosses the slow EMA; only the crossing bar signals.

families.label: Volatility-adjusted time-series momentum
families.mechanism: Completed multi-bar return is divided by realized one-bar return volatility; a signal occurs only when the score crosses a fixed positive or negative threshold.

families.label: Statistical-band re-entry mean reversion
families.mechanism: The previous close is outside a completed rolling mean band and the current close re-enters; the signal is toward the rolling mean.

families.label: Large-return shock reversal
families.mechanism: A completed multi-bar move exceeds a fixed ATR multiple and the signal bar reverses by a minimum ATR fraction; the signal opposes the completed shock.

families.label: Major-session handoff continuation or reversal
families.mechanism: A completed reference session must have directional efficiency above a fixed threshold. The first bar of the next major session confirms continuation or reversal; entry is the next M15 open.

families.label: ATR-normalized directional-change filter rule
families.mechanism: A stateful filter rule changes direction only after close moves a fixed ATR multiple away from the running extreme since the previous directional change.
